parsing_traps.description: pp.54-59 show 'Agreed Property Value at Acquisition (million)' — this is HISTORICAL COST, not current fair value. The audited Portfolio Statement (pp.127-143) shows current carrying value in $'000. The valuation tier labels in the report are: Portfolio Listing = Tier B/historical; Portfolio Statement = Tier C. Never use Portfolio Listing for market_valuation.

parsing_traps.trap: BT Group Investment Properties vs BT Group PPE
parsing_traps.description: BT Group has TWO property classifications in the Portfolio Statement: (a) Investment Properties — Sotetsu Grand Fresa Osaka-Namba, ibis Ambassador Seoul Insadong, Sotetsu Hotels The Splaisir Seoul Dongdaemun (all with $'000 values on p142); (b) Freehold Land and Buildings (PPE) — 5 Pullman/Mercure/Temple Bar properties on p143 (% only, aggregate $'000); (c) Leasehold Land and Buildings (PPE) — The Robertson House Singapore on p138/144 ($'000 available). All three sub-types must be included in properties.json but classified correctly.

The Statement of Total Return (p114) and the balance sheet have three columns: REIT Group, BT Group, Stapled Group (consolidated). Always extract from the Stapled Group column. The REIT Group column excludes BT properties; the BT Group column excludes REIT properties.

parsing_traps.trap: Citadines Central Shinjuku Tokyo still in Portfolio Listing
parsing_traps.description: The Portfolio Listing (p54-59) shows Citadines Central Shinjuku Tokyo with its historical acquisition value, but this property was DIVESTED on 2 October 2025. It does NOT appear in the year-end audited Portfolio Statement (pp.132-136). market_valuation = null for this divested property.

The industry mix on p27 ('FY 2025 Portfolio Information by Industry') is explicitly scoped to corporate accounts of properties under Ascott management contracts ONLY. This excludes master lease and MCMGI properties. The 100% total represents the corporate segment within management-contract properties, not the entire portfolio. pct_basis must capture this verbatim.

p8 Financial Highlights shows S$ millions rounded. p9 may show the Stapled Group audited equivalent. For performance.json, gross_revenue and net_property_income were sourced from p114 Statement of Total Return ($'000) and p213 (Notes), then scaled to absolute units.

Indonesia properties use HGB (Hak Guna Bangunan = right-to-build) which is a leasehold structure specific to Indonesian law. Ascott Kuningan Jakarta has only 1 year remaining (30y lease, expires ~2026-2027). This is a significant lease renewal risk that should be flagged.

data_provenance.basis: Note 30 (Earnings per Stapled Security), p219: 'Weighted average number of Stapled Securities outstanding during the year' = 3,817,484 ('000) → absolute 3,817,484,000 units. Includes effect of acquisition fees, divestment fees, and management fees paid in Stapled Securities during the year.

Note 30 (Earnings per Stapled Security), p219: 'Weighted average number of Stapled Securities outstanding (diluted) during the year' = 3,844,271 ('000) → absolute 3,844,271,000. CORRECTED from prior extraction which incorrectly stored the basic figure (3,817,484,000) in this field. The pre-existing _notes.json diluted_shares_note already documented both values correctly but the financial.json field was wrong.

Distribution Statement p116: only ONE distributable income figure disclosed ('Income available for distribution to Stapled Securityholders for the year' = S$256,708k = net_distributable_income). Managers' management fees paid/payable in Stapled Securities (S$28,199k per Note A) are added BACK as a distribution adjustment. No separate adjusted figure after fees deducted in cash. Set to null (single DI figure).

Distribution Statement p116 + narrative p160/p1109: for-the-year total distribution = 'Income available for distribution to Stapled Securityholders for the year' 256,708 ('000) less 'Amount retained for asset enhancement initiatives and/or for general corporate and working capital purposes' 23,200 ('000) = 233,508 ('000) → absolute 233,508,000. Confirmed by narrative 'Total distribution was S$233.5 million, after retaining S$23.2 million' and the 5-Year Summary 'Total Distribution 233.5'. DPU 6.10c relates to FY2025. NOT the '(231,247)' line, which mixes prior-year cash. Retained check: 256,708,000 − 233,508,000 = 23,200,000 = the disclosed retention. Figures in '000, multiplied to absolute.
Phase-1 tag 2026-06-23: distribution_paid is the disclosed for-the-year amount-to-be-distributed (after retention); NDI - distribution_paid = the disclosed retention.
